programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Duggee thought his tie was a little bit plain, so he added some accessories and now it looks amazing. The Squirrels admire Duggee’s new look and want to learn how to accessorise themselves. The first step for the Squirrels is to find something they’d like to change. The Squirrels each bring a different item - wellies, a T-shirt, headband, helmet and… a potato. They grab sequins, patches, feathers and lights, and then showcase what they have all done. Norrie has added sequins to her T-shirt and made it into a new wonderfully sparkly outfit. Betty has added loads of useful items to her headband, like a calculator and a pencil, to wear it on all occasions. Roly has painted glow-in-the-dark paint on his wellies, and now he can splash in the dark. Tag has painted his helmet and added horns so he looks super-turbo! Roly has turned his potato into a beautifully made-up face with pink and yellow hair. The Squirrels want to accessorise everything. Soon enough, the whole of the Clubhouse and the town are new and improved, but the Squirrels are getting tired. There’s a chance they may have got carried away, so they go to work toning it down a touch. Less is more!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Duggee masters his ambition of building a model of the Clubhouse out of sticks, so the Squirrels start to think about what their ambitions might be. Norrie wants to learn how to break dance. Happy has always wanted to jump the famous triple puddle splash. Betty has always wanted to teach Mr Cuddles how to speak Portuguese. Roly has loads, from growing a potato to becoming a pirate. Tag spends a long time thinking what his could be, and then it clicks - he needs to climb over the log! Duggee gets to work helping all of the Squirrels train so they can reach their goals. Duggee teaches them that while it may be hard, the important thing is to keep trying and eventually you’ll get there. The Squirrels achieve their ambitions, and Tag successfully climbs over the log. Now they have achieved their first ambitions, the Squirrels can continue to reach for the stars. And they know Duggee is proud of them no matter what they achieve, and that they should be proud of themselves!

programme.title: Zog and the Flying Doctors
programme.desc: Zog and Gadabout try to rescue Princess Pearl, who has been locked up in her uncle's castle. Based on the book by Julia Donaldson and Axel Scheffler.

programme.title: Go Jetters
programme.desc: Foz tries to play an old Spanish guitar, and Xuli is delighted when her first ever souvenir selfie flutters out of it. It shows her on holiday as a child in a Spanish town with her long-lost friend Maria. Foz suggests they visit Maria, but there is a problem: Xuli was so young when she used to holiday there that she can't remember where it was! Luckily, Foz's keen eyes quickly spot an important clue, and soon they are searching across Spain in hope of a reunion.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: Weasy keeps losing at coconut shy, so he uses a time-stopping machine to cheat.

programme.title: Spidey and His Amazing Friends
programme.desc: Doc Ock makes statues. Spidey's boots are taken.

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: It’s an underwater mystery when a valuable protective shell goes missing.

programme.title: Stan Can
programme.desc: Stan makes a snowplough to help the town on a very snowy day.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Supertato runs in fright when Pumpkin tries to make friends with him, but he later realises she needs his help as she’s stuck in the air hanging from balloons set up by Evil Pea.

programme.title: Talking Tom Heroes: Suddenly Super
programme.desc: The villains team up to take down the Peak City Heroes.

programme.title: Small Potatoes
programme.desc: Animated series about a group of singing potatoes. The Small Potatoes explore different jobs, from firemen to astronauts, in this disco pageant.

programme.title: Monster Makes
programme.desc: Rebecca is engrossed in her new book, but Murphi needs feeding. To help deal with his hunger, Rebecca works with him to make tiger bread toast. The Mini Monsters serve up some fantastic dishy animal makes, and Rebecca’s cousin calls with an animal story of his own. None of this excitement is enough to keep Murphi’s tummy quiet. Perhaps the final mega monster make will help – a bottle street.

programme.title: Big Cook Little Cook
programme.desc: Jen has been playing in the rain puddles, but Small doesn’t have any sensible shoes to wear. Puss in Boots, the magical cat, comes to visit. Small flies off on her spoon to find out how to catch fish, and the two chefs cook a fishcake crown for their purrrfect guest.

programme.title: Let's Go for a Walk
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers walk along a canal to a place where they can blow bubbles. On the way, they discover a lift for boats, pretend to be pirates, spot some canal boats and even meet an octopus!

programme.title: Balamory
programme.desc: PC Plum uses Ava’s doubling machine by mistake and multiplies all his recycling. But with Dr Ollie’s help, it becomes Cyclo the Recycling Robot, giving the children lots of fun.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Duggee introduces the Squirrels to his friend Eugene, the leader of the Big Parade, who has lost his hat. The Squirrels find him a new hat to wear from their dressing-up box, and off Eugene goes. But then - oh dear! - he hurts his leg and can't lead the parade after all. Can Duggee and the Squirrels help out? You bet they can! Stand by for the best Big Parade ever!

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: Juno’s best friend is a baby bird and they talk all day, but when anyone else talks to him, he freezes up. Vida figures out the problem—he’s shy—and gives the baby bird some tools to help him cope.

programme.title: Go Jetters
programme.desc: Animated adventure comedy series. The team gets all shook up when Glitch sucks up the pink water of Senegal's Milkshake Lake.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Rafi, Ruby and Finn play football against Khia’s team. Rafi is goalie, but she keeps missing shots and feels under pressure. She makes a wish for giant hands to save every ball. When the wish ends, Rafi worries she’ll lose, but Ruby and Finn remind her she’s already a great goalie. Believing in herself, Rafi makes a fingertip save on Khia’s penalty and wins the game fairly.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: Yukee and TapTap spend the night in a tent and are surprised to meet some beautiful, musical fireflies!

programme.title: Froglets
programme.desc: On a rainy day, the Froglets create a shadow show for Bertie and their puppet friends.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: It’s showtime! Justin and his friends put on a play, whilst Mr Tumble has a go at making a puppet theatre. But managing all his actors proves harder than he thought.

programme.title: The Toddler Club
programme.desc: Nigel, Benjee Bear and Bailee Bear welcome toddlers Seren, Ella, Dylan, Erin and Betsy, and their grown-ups, to the Toddler Club. Parents, carers and their little ones at home are invited to join in with all the fun activities too! The What’s in the Box? game reveals a wooden birthday cake, and when the toddlers and parents open up a bigger box, they discover lots more objects and toys that are inspired by a birthday party theme. This subject is explored through play, song and story. Grown-ups are encouraged to take part at home by hiding a safe, toddler-appropriate birthday party toy or object inside a recycled box for them to reveal and explore with their toddler! Storytime is all about fun and playful discovery, as the Toddler Twins’ friend Koala throws a surprise birthday party for Panda! Viewers at home show how they’ve been exploring the birthday party theme too. And, The Big Band Song gets everyone moving about, before some calm time with stretching and the Goodbye song.

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: Lou sings a song to conquer his fear but wakes a sleeping dinosaur.

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: Three bunnies want to become builders, so the Piggies teach them. Though experts at building, the Piggies aren’t great teachers. The lessons quickly become messy and chaotic!

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Ted and his family head to the beach, and Ted tries his hand at making a sandcastle. When it doesn’t go quite to plan, Dad shows him some top tips. After some fun flying a kite, the family enjoy a game of catch. And what trip to the beach is complete without an ice cream?

programme.title: Stan Can
programme.desc: Stan makes a snowplough to help the town on a very snowy day.

programme.title: The Game Catchers
programme.desc: The Game Catchers land on Book Planet and learn to play tower of cups, but the game is interrupted after a lost Sparkstar needs help finding the book it came from!

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Split has an itch but no scratching stick. Ginger and the Pea-Rexes get creative to help.

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: Red is surprised to discover that she's not the only colour in the world when she meets Blue. Join the Colourblocks to learn which objects can be red and which can be blue, and how some can be both red and blue.

programme.title: Monster Makes
programme.desc: It’s a really hot day in the attic, and Murphi needs to cool the place down to stop Rebecca getting crabby. A paper plate crab is the first make of the day, with the usual supportive song from the Fabulous Fluffs. An old wooden spoon becomes a spoon monster, thanks to the creativity of the Mini Monsters, and Rebecca’s cousin builds a paper bag house. The Recycling Express provides yogurt pots for a palm tree, and the Tiny Helpers make the leaves.

programme.title: Talking Tom Heroes: Suddenly Super
programme.desc: Kranium zaps Ben’s friends into toddler versions of themselves.

programme.title: Ranger Hamza's Eco Quest
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers make a cosy house for hedgehogs using a scrap cardboard box and some sticks and leaves. They learn why hedgehogs are important creatures to encourage to our outdoor spaces.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island
programme.desc: When a pterosaur destroys Jen’s dino proximity machine, Andy goes on an adventure to retrieve the pieces. Along the way, he meets velociraptors, an Alamosaurus and some hungry Gorgosaurus.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: It’s time for some fun at Squirrel Club! Professor Jeanie talks to us about all things butterflies, the Squirrels have their annual Squirrel Club photograph taken, and there's a quiz presented by Mouse. For the finale, the Squirrels are back with a song about the power of saying no!

programme.title: Tiny Tunes
programme.desc: Lisa and the children create binoculars using recycled tubes and decorations, learn British Sign Language signs for sailor, sea and see, then sing and sign A Sailor Went to Sea, Sea, Sea.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Split is terrified of sliding down the necks of giant Broccolisaurus.

programme.title: Nick Cope's Popcast
programme.desc: Nick and Norman are stuck up a 100-year-old oak tree. Nick discovers Grandpa’s old guitar and remembers playing it many years ago with his mum under the same old oak tree.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: It's a very hot day in Sweetwood, and Tidbit is really tired. Luckily, Vida knows why - he needs to hydrate! Vida helps Tidbit find a way to play and hydrate at the same time.

programme.title: Big Lizard
programme.desc: When a meteorite splashes into the sea, Dad and Cosima cause problems by claiming it in the name of science, against the wishes of the sea creatures.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Finn puts on a magic show at the bakery and wants to do it all by himself. It goes well - until he gets stuck. Rafi secretly makes a wish, and suddenly his hat is full of bunnies! The crowd laughs, but Finn is upset that the show isn’t his anymore. With Ruby’s help, they use carrot cake to guide the bunnies back into the hat. When the wish ends, Finn finishes the show on his own. He proves he can shine, and Rafi realises that friends sometimes need space to do things their own way.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran press a flower so that it will last for a long time. JoJo learns that flowers wilt over time, but flower pressing is a special way to make them last longer. JoJo and Gran Gran look through Gran Gran's wedding album and enjoy old photographs, special things and happy memories. Gran Gran realises they have found the perfect place to keep their special pressed flower.

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Animation. Sarah and her best friend Duck embark on simple but exciting adventures, exploring the world both near and far in their own wobbly and imaginative way. Scarf Lady has run out of wool, so Sarah and Duck help her to harvest the weeping woollen tree.

programme.title: Charlie and Lola
programme.desc: Children's animation. Lola is overjoyed when Lotta finally agrees to do swaps: Lola can borrow Lotta's brand new fluffy white coat in exchange for Lola's clippy handbag. Even though Lola has promised to be extremely very careful, things do not go as planned. How can she possibly own up to Lotta that her brand new white fluffy coat is lost?

programme.title: Moon and Me
programme.desc: Mr Onion is riding on the Bumparoller when he discovers a great big hole in the road. What are we going to do? Mr Onion knows how to fix it!

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: MeMo and BaBa show Gramma Leeba a photo of themselves and match the pose. On the way to the Play Tree, they spot shapes in the clouds. They choose a picture book to play with and match the shapes to each other and all their friends. The game is easy for MeMo, but BaBa needs a little more help. MeMo kindly helps BaBa to play the game until it’s time for BeddyByes.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: In a magical forest, colourful characters have adventures and are read stories. Upsy Daisy is riding in the Ninky Nonk when she sees her bed. She gets off and decides to have a rest in her bed. Igglepiggle is trying to find somewhere soft to have a rest. Upsy Daisy gets up after her rest and goes for a walk. Igglepiggle then gets into Upsy Daisy's bed. Only Upsy Daisy is allowed to sleep in Upsy Daisy's bed and Upsy Daisy is coming back! Out jumps Igglepiggle and off they chase.

programme.title: CBeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: Abbie Ward reads a celebratory story that explores the world of rugby through a child’s eyes.

programme.title: This Is CBeebies
programme.desc: Programmes start at 6.00am.

programme.title: This Is CBeebies
programme.desc: Programmes start at 6.00am.

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: The Colourblocks decorate Purple's garden and learn about patterns. Discover how to make your own patterns with the Colourblocks.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Oona and Silky try to find a fun game they can play together.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing has broken his arm and is struggling to do his usual activities. Petting Arlo hurts, playing with blocks hurts, and even drinking juice hurts. But when Bing and Sula draw together it doesn't hurt, and so he forgets about his arm and does a big, painful 'hoppity voosh'! Amma gently explains to Bing, Sula and Flop that when she broke her arm, she learnt that sometimes you have to ask for help.

programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc: Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny has a dance competition out of town. Love Monster misses her while she is gone and worries that he didn’t wish her good luck.

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: The Bunnies' sleeping mobile breaks, so the Piggy Builders come up with great ideas to create a new one. But the improvements amuse the Bunnies so much that they are too excited to sleep!

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Ginger and the Peas encounter a pack of Radishraptors who steal their delicious pop drops!

programme.title: Roots and Fruits
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it’s Carrot performing a superstylish song - if he manages to make up his mind and pick an outfit.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Farmer Jackson was just trying to grow some giant tomatoes, but he wound up with a giant pig! Now, Mojo and Bo have to get Felix back to normal size before Swoppiton gets stomped.

programme.title: Chuggington
programme.desc: Look up in the sky! Is it a bird? A plane? No, it's Space Chuggers! Adventure ensues when the trainees prepare for a visit with Chuggers from outer space.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Supertato and the Tato Team must battle to save Tato Tower from Evil Pea's earth-shaking stomping performance at the Veg-O-Vision Song Contest.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: 'If you get shy then your friends can help you.' Bing and his friends put on a show in the park. After Coco's dance, Pando's song and Sula's acrobatics display, everyone is excited to see Bing's finale. When he gets up on the stage, Bing is overcome with stage fright, so his friends and rainbow fairy mice come to the rescue.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Sula’s cousin Nicky is visiting, something Bing is a little unsure about. Sula and Bing start making 'rippy pictures', and while Sula is looking for some purple paper Bing shows Nicky how to voosh the blue speedy car down the slide. However, Nicky vooshes too, falling and breaking his glasses! Sula is furious and Bing is forlorn. Amma soothes Bing while Nicky shows him that he can click his glasses back together again.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels have played with all their toys, and they are frustrated because they feel they have nothing left to do. Duggee tells them that there’s always limitless fun if you use your imagination. He explains that you can use your mind to pretend to do or be anything you want and demonstrates how he can imagine he’s a dancer or even a horse. The Squirrels take turns thinking of what they want to be or what they want to do. At first, not everyone gets the hang of it, but soon enough, they all embark on their greatest adventure yet, in the new world they have imagined. Together, they can speed through space or float through an underwater world, where Norrie is a rock star and Tag can be king. All that immersive fun can happen just from the clubhouse!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels are admiring everything Duggee has grown in his vegetable garden, especially his crop of giant carrots, when they hear a noise. They investigate and find the Rabbits busy preparing for the Carrot Solstice, the day when the sun is at its highest. On this day, they gather round Carrot Henge to celebrate the glory of this humble vegetable. Trouble is, the Rabbits need to go and get ready – but who will look after the carrots? The Squirrels volunteer, so off the Rabbits go. Looking after the carrots seems easy at first, and Norrie arranges tasks for everyone. Betty skillfully organises the queue while Roly is on toilet duty. And then, disaster strikes. Worm pops up and eats part of Carrot Henge. Duggee is dispatched to fetch one of his own giant carrots to fill the gap. As time ticks on with no Duggee in sight, the place gets busier, and the sun is nearly at the top. Will Duggee fix the Henge in time, or will Carrot Solstice be ruined?

programme.title: Go Jetters
programme.desc: The Go Jetters are at the top of the world, helping Professor Wave research polar bears in the Arctic Ocean. Climate change is causing the polar bears's ice home to melt away. Although they get to see a wild polar bear called Kalik, trouble strikes when Foz and Kyan waste too much energy on heat and run down the ship's power! With a chunk of melting ice heading towards them, the Go Jetters see the perils caused by climate change first hand, and they spring into action to find a way to save the ship.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: Benjamin and Cotton-tail become lost in the Shadowy Woods during a game of peekaboo. Can Peter use this very same game to help them elude a prowling Mr Tod?

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: Join Captain Barnacles and his intrepid band of explorers, The Octonauts, for more deep sea adventures. The Octonauts roam the oceans in search of adventure and fun. Whether it's a perilous voyage to the bottom of the sea or the piratey pursuit of a giant squid, the Octonauts leap into action and always prove that eight heads are better than one. While exploring a dark and spooky cave, the Octonauts discover the fossil of a powerful, prehistoric fish... but it may be more than just a fossil.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: Juno can’t wait for Juno Mama Day, but when Mama Hippo gets a cold, it’s a very different day than Juno expected. Luckily, she learns that she’s a great junior nurse!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: A shark on the loose in the streets of Swoppiton? Mojo and Bo are on a fishing trip to find out more! But the hungry shark might not be quite as hungry-sharky as they think.

programme.title: Activate with Joe Wicks
programme.desc: My AstroBurp Challenge is ready for launch! Are you ready to activate light speed? In this challenge, we're going to blast through squats, star jumps and burpees. Final destination: the Activate! Get ready to move with Joe and the Activators.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Mr Tumble tidies up his bedroom. Meanwhile, Justin and his friends play in a recycling band!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Playing butterflies in the backyard is great fun, until Bluey runs away with Judo, leaving Bingo all alone. Now poor Bingo is heartbroken, and Bluey needs to make amends.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: During a heavy summer storm, Bluey is determined to dam the water in the front yard.

programme.desc: Ted and his family head to the beach, and Ted tries his hand at making a sandcastle. When it doesn’t go quite to plan, Dad shows him some top tips. After some fun flying a kite, the family enjoy a game of catch. And what trip to the beach is complete without an ice cream?

programme.title: Stan Can
programme.desc: Stan makes a snowplough to help the town on a very snowy day.

programme.title: The Game Catchers
programme.desc: The Game Catchers land on Book Planet and learn to play tower of cups, but the game is interrupted after a lost Sparkstar needs help finding the book it came from!

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Split has an itch but no scratching stick. Ginger and the Pea-Rexes get creative to help.

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: Red is surprised to discover that she's not the only colour in the world when she meets Blue. Join the Colourblocks to learn which objects can be red and which can be blue, and how some can be both red and blue.

programme.title: Monster Makes
programme.desc: It’s a really hot day in the attic, and Murphi needs to cool the place down to stop Rebecca getting crabby. A paper plate crab is the first make of the day, with the usual supportive song from the Fabulous Fluffs. An old wooden spoon becomes a spoon monster, thanks to the creativity of the Mini Monsters, and Rebecca’s cousin builds a paper bag house. The Recycling Express provides yogurt pots for a palm tree, and the Tiny Helpers make the leaves.

programme.title: Talking Tom Heroes: Suddenly Super
programme.desc: Kranium zaps Ben’s friends into toddler versions of themselves.

programme.title: Ranger Hamza's Eco Quest
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers make a cosy house for hedgehogs using a scrap cardboard box and some sticks and leaves. They learn why hedgehogs are important creatures to encourage to our outdoor spaces.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island
programme.desc: When a pterosaur destroys Jen’s dino proximity machine, Andy goes on an adventure to retrieve the pieces. Along the way, he meets velociraptors, an Alamosaurus and some hungry Gorgosaurus.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: It’s time for some fun at Squirrel Club! Professor Jeanie talks to us about all things butterflies, the Squirrels have their annual Squirrel Club photograph taken, and there's a quiz presented by Mouse. For the finale, the Squirrels are back with a song about the power of saying no!

programme.title: Tiny Tunes
programme.desc: Lisa and the children create binoculars using recycled tubes and decorations, learn British Sign Language signs for sailor, sea and see, then sing and sign A Sailor Went to Sea, Sea, Sea.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Split is terrified of sliding down the necks of giant Broccolisaurus.

programme.title: Nick Cope's Popcast
programme.desc: Nick and Norman are stuck up a 100-year-old oak tree. Nick discovers Grandpa’s old guitar and remembers playing it many years ago with his mum under the same old oak tree.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: It's a very hot day in Sweetwood, and Tidbit is really tired. Luckily, Vida knows why - he needs to hydrate! Vida helps Tidbit find a way to play and hydrate at the same time.

programme.title: Big Lizard
programme.desc: When a meteorite splashes into the sea, Dad and Cosima cause problems by claiming it in the name of science, against the wishes of the sea creatures.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Finn puts on a magic show at the bakery and wants to do it all by himself. It goes well - until he gets stuck. Rafi secretly makes a wish, and suddenly his hat is full of bunnies! The crowd laughs, but Finn is upset that the show isn’t his anymore. With Ruby’s help, they use carrot cake to guide the bunnies back into the hat. When the wish ends, Finn finishes the show on his own. He proves he can shine, and Rafi realises that friends sometimes need space to do things their own way.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran press a flower so that it will last for a long time. JoJo learns that flowers wilt over time, but flower pressing is a special way to make them last longer. JoJo and Gran Gran look through Gran Gran's wedding album and enjoy old photographs, special things and happy memories. Gran Gran realises they have found the perfect place to keep their special pressed flower.

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Animation. Sarah and her best friend Duck embark on simple but exciting adventures, exploring the world both near and far in their own wobbly and imaginative way. Scarf Lady has run out of wool, so Sarah and Duck help her to harvest the weeping woollen tree.

programme.title: Charlie and Lola
programme.desc: Children's animation. Lola is overjoyed when Lotta finally agrees to do swaps: Lola can borrow Lotta's brand new fluffy white coat in exchange for Lola's clippy handbag. Even though Lola has promised to be extremely very careful, things do not go as planned. How can she possibly own up to Lotta that her brand new white fluffy coat is lost?

programme.title: Moon and Me
programme.desc: Mr Onion is riding on the Bumparoller when he discovers a great big hole in the road. What are we going to do? Mr Onion knows how to fix it!

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: MeMo and BaBa show Gramma Leeba a photo of themselves and match the pose. On the way to the Play Tree, they spot shapes in the clouds. They choose a picture book to play with and match the shapes to each other and all their friends. The game is easy for MeMo, but BaBa needs a little more help. MeMo kindly helps BaBa to play the game until it’s time for BeddyByes.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: In a magical forest, colourful characters have adventures and are read stories. Upsy Daisy is riding in the Ninky Nonk when she sees her bed. She gets off and decides to have a rest in her bed. Igglepiggle is trying to find somewhere soft to have a rest. Upsy Daisy gets up after her rest and goes for a walk. Igglepiggle then gets into Upsy Daisy's bed. Only Upsy Daisy is allowed to sleep in Upsy Daisy's bed and Upsy Daisy is coming back! Out jumps Igglepiggle and off they chase.

programme.title: CBeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: Abbie Ward reads a celebratory story that explores the world of rugby through a child’s eyes.

programme.title: Believe Me
programme.desc: In 2008, it becomes clear that a cab-driving serial rapist is operating in London. A new team led by Tim Grattan-Kane launches a desperate manhunt. An appeal leads a nurse who treated Laila to contact the police, which results in Worboys' arrest. Sarah and Laila, whose lives have been deeply affected by their traumatic experiences, learn of this via the media, which causes them distress. Dozens of other potential victims come forward, including Carrie, who realises that he must have drugged her too. The strong evidence leads to Worboys' conviction and he is sentenced to a minimum of eight years. Carrie agrees to waive her anonymity and do interviews to encourage other victims to step forward. Outraged by their treatment, Sarah and Laila approach renowned solicitor Harriet Wistrich and decide to take the unprecedented step of suing the Metropolitan Police. They are concerned about Worboys' minimum term of only eight years, but police reassure them that he is unlikely to receive parole.

programme.desc: National and international news with reports and analysis from ITV's Correspondents in the UK and around the world. [S]

programme.title: The Family Next Door
programme.desc: The first episode of an Australian mystery drama. An enigmatic woman, Isabelle, abruptly leaves a wake and drives interstate all the way to Osprey Point, a small coastal town in Victoria - she arrives at her rental in a quiet suburban cul-de-sac called Pleasant Court and is met by neighbour and nosy estate agent Ange. Ange gently pushes Isabelle for information and senses that Isabelle is not who she says she is - her interest is piqued and she is determined to find out more. Ange's intrigue of Isabelle infiltrates the Court - Fran, Essie, Lulu and Holly - and it isn't long before their regular 'wine o'clock' turns to gossip about this mysterious new neighbour.

programme.title: The Family Next Door
programme.desc: Australian mystery drama. Essie feels a disconnection with motherhood both physically and emotionally - living with her mother isn't helping, and she feels judged and guilt-ridden that her experience of motherhood is not joyful. After a frightening incident at the playground involving her baby, Essie gets to know her enigmatic new neighbour a little better - Isabelle seems to represent everything Essie once had with her freedom, adventure, sense of self and anonymity... and it's alluring. After the park, home life becomes even more claustrophobic with Barb and Ben aware of Essie's dishonesty - buoyed by her time with Isabelle, she gets honest with Ben about her feelings around motherhood. Elsewhere, Ange seeks some legal advice from Fran while remaining anxious about Isabelle and her interest with Lucas - especially after seeing them together at the Nippers BBQ - and Isabelle makes a shocking discovery after surprising Lucas at his studio with payment for his photography work.

programme.title: Believe Me
programme.desc: In 2008, it becomes clear that a cab-driving serial rapist is operating in London. A new team led by Tim Grattan-Kane launches a desperate manhunt. An appeal leads a nurse who treated Laila to contact the police, which results in Worboys' arrest. Sarah and Laila, whose lives have been deeply affected by their traumatic experiences, learn of this via the media, which causes them distress. Dozens of other potential victims come forward, including Carrie, who realises that he must have drugged her too. The strong evidence leads to Worboys' conviction and he is sentenced to a minimum of eight years. Carrie agrees to waive her anonymity and do interviews to encourage other victims to step forward. Outraged by their treatment, Sarah and Laila approach renowned solicitor Harriet Wistrich and decide to take the unprecedented step of suing the Metropolitan Police. They are concerned about Worboys' minimum term of only eight years, but police reassure them that he is unlikely to receive parole.

programme.title: The Family Next Door
programme.desc: The first episode of an Australian mystery drama. An enigmatic woman, Isabelle, abruptly leaves a wake and drives interstate all the way to Osprey Point, a small coastal town in Victoria - she arrives at her rental in a quiet suburban cul-de-sac called Pleasant Court and is met by neighbour and nosy estate agent Ange. Ange gently pushes Isabelle for information and senses that Isabelle is not who she says she is - her interest is piqued and she is determined to find out more. programme.title: The Family Next Door
programme.desc: Australian mystery drama. Essie feels a disconnection with motherhood both physically and emotionally - living with her mother isn't helping, and she feels judged and guilt-ridden that her experience of motherhood is not joyful. After a frightening incident at the playground involving her baby, Essie gets to know her enigmatic new neighbour a little better - Isabelle seems to represent everything Essie once had with her freedom, adventure, sense of self and anonymity... and it's alluring. After the park, home life becomes even more claustrophobic with Barb and Ben aware of Essie's dishonesty - buoyed by her time with Isabelle, she gets honest with Ben about her feelings around motherhood. Elsewhere, Ange seeks some legal advice from Fran while remaining anxious about Isabelle and her interest with Lucas - especially after seeing them together at the Nippers BBQ - and Isabelle makes a shocking discovery after surprising Lucas at his studio with payment for his photography work.

programme.title: The Tower
programme.desc: Crime thriller. Armed with an ID for Spencer's killer, Lizzie persuades Kieran to open up Operation Perseus to Sarah so she can make the arrest - however, it's clear that Sarah and Kieran loath one another even with Lizzie acting as a peacemaker. After testing Steve's cover at gunpoint, Shakiel invites him to become his number two - Kieran and Steve then realise that Shakiel is about to make a move that will give him control of south London, but they plan to be in the right place to stop him. Shakiel always has a card up his sleeve, though, and this time it's Ryan Kennedy.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: James's journey takes him to the bustling Provencal port of Marseille - he begins the day there in the old port, where the fishermen are selling fresh seafood from the back of their boats. James buys some sea bass for an outdoor cook on the quayside - venturing into town, he then visits Marseille's oldest bakery and learns the history and importance of the famous navette biscuit. James then goes in search of the best example of Marseille's most famous dish - bouillabaisse - and takes his beloved 2CV to the world-famous Circuit Paul Ricard, where he prepares his take on piperade. In keeping with the fish and seafood theme, James also cooks scallops St Jacques and wreckfish with buckwheat.

programme.title: Josie's Taste Of The Westcountry
programme.desc: Proud Bristolian Josie Gibson takes us on a tour of her beloved West Country in a journey of celebration to discover dinner delights, freshly-caught lunches, the best of passionate artisan makers and growers and a few hidden gems to surprise us all - in this episode, Josie visits Devon, the county where national parks and beaches abound, to discover some of the old legends of Dartmoor. programme.title: The Family Next Door

programme.desc: In 2008, it becomes clear that a cab-driving serial rapist is operating in London. A new team led by Tim Grattan-Kane launches a desperate manhunt. programme.title: The Family Next Door
programme.desc: Australian mystery drama. Essie feels a disconnection with motherhood both physically and emotionally - living with her mother isn't helping, and she feels judged and guilt-ridden that her experience of motherhood is not joyful. programme.desc: Crime thriller. Shakiel always has a card up his sleeve, though, and this time it's Ryan Kennedy.

programme.title: The Family Next Door

programme.title: The Family Next Door
programme.desc: Australian mystery drama. Essie feels a disconnection with motherhood both physically and emotionally - living with her mother isn't helping, and she feels judged and guilt-ridden that her experience of motherhood is not joyful. After a frightening incident at the playground involving her baby, Essie gets to know her enigmatic new neighbour a little better - Isabelle seems to represent everything Essie once had with her freedom, adventure, sense of self and anonymity... and it's alluring. After the park, home life becomes even more claustrophobic with Barb and Ben aware of Essie's dishonesty - buoyed by her time with Isabelle, she gets honest with Ben about her feelings around motherhood. Elsewhere, Ange seeks some legal advice from Fran while remaining anxious about Isabelle and her interest with Lucas - especially after seeing them together at the Nippers BBQ - and Isabelle makes a shocking discovery after surprising Lucas at his studio with payment for his photography work.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: James's journey takes him to the bustling Provencal port of Marseille - he begins the day there in the old port, where the fishermen are selling fresh seafood from the back of their boats. James buys some sea bass for an outdoor cook on the quayside - venturing into town, he then visits Marseille's oldest bakery and learns the history and importance of the famous navette biscuit. James then goes in search of the best example of Marseille's most famous dish - bouillabaisse - and takes his beloved 2CV to the world-famous Circuit Paul Ricard, where he prepares his take on piperade. In keeping with the fish and seafood theme, James also cooks scallops St Jacques and wreckfish with buckwheat.

programme.title: Believe Me
programme.desc: In 2008, it becomes clear that a cab-driving serial rapist is operating in London. A new team led by Tim Grattan-Kane launches a desperate manhunt. An appeal leads a nurse who treated Laila to contact the police, which results in Worboys' arrest. Sarah and Laila, whose lives have been deeply affected by their traumatic experiences, learn of this via the media, which causes them distress. Dozens of other potential victims come forward, including Carrie, who realises that he must have drugged her too. The strong evidence leads to Worboys' conviction and he is sentenced to a minimum of eight years. Carrie agrees to waive her anonymity and do interviews to encourage other victims to step forward. Outraged by their treatment, Sarah and Laila approach renowned solicitor Harriet Wistrich and decide to take the unprecedented step of suing the Metropolitan Police. They are concerned about Worboys' minimum term of only eight years, but police reassure them that he is unlikely to receive parole.

programme.title: The Family Next Door
programme.desc: The first episode of an Australian mystery drama. An enigmatic woman, Isabelle, abruptly leaves a wake and drives interstate all the way to Osprey Point, a small coastal town in Victoria - she arrives at her rental in a quiet suburban cul-de-sac called Pleasant Court and is met by neighbour and nosy estate agent Ange. Ange gently pushes Isabelle for information and senses that Isabelle is not who she says she is - her interest is piqued and she is determined to find out more. Ange's intrigue of Isabelle infiltrates the Court - Fran, Essie, Lulu and Holly - and it isn't long before their regular 'wine o'clock' turns to gossip about this mysterious new neighbour.

programme.title: The Family Next Door
programme.desc: Australian mystery drama. Essie feels a disconnection with motherhood both physically and emotionally - living with her mother isn't helping, and she feels judged and guilt-ridden that her experience of motherhood is not joyful. After a frightening incident at the playground involving her baby, Essie gets to know her enigmatic new neighbour a little better - Isabelle seems to represent everything Essie once had with her freedom, adventure, sense of self and anonymity... and it's alluring. After the park, home life becomes even more claustrophobic with Barb and Ben aware of Essie's dishonesty - buoyed by her time with Isabelle, she gets honest with Ben about her feelings around motherhood. Elsewhere, Ange seeks some legal advice from Fran while remaining anxious about Isabelle and her interest with Lucas - especially after seeing them together at the Nippers BBQ - and Isabelle makes a shocking discovery after surprising Lucas at his studio with payment for his photography work.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: James's journey takes him to the bustling Provencal port of Marseille - he begins the day there in the old port, where the fishermen are selling fresh seafood from the back of their boats. James buys some sea bass for an outdoor cook on the quayside - venturing into town, he then visits Marseille's oldest bakery and learns the history and importance of the famous navette biscuit. James then goes in search of the best example of Marseille's most famous dish - bouillabaisse - and takes his beloved 2CV to the world-famous Circuit Paul Ricard, where he prepares his take on piperade. In keeping with the fish and seafood theme, James also cooks scallops St Jacques and wreckfish with buckwheat.

Sarah and Laila, whose lives have been deeply affected by their traumatic experiences, learn of this via the media, which causes them distress. Dozens of other potential victims come forward, including Carrie, who realises that he must have drugged her too. The strong evidence leads to Worboys' conviction and he is sentenced to a minimum of eight years. Carrie agrees to waive her anonymity and do interviews to encourage other victims to step forward. Outraged by their treatment, Sarah and Laila approach renowned solicitor Harriet Wistrich and decide to take the unprecedented step of suing the Metropolitan Police. They are concerned about Worboys' minimum term of only eight years, but police reassure them that he is unlikely to receive parole.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: James's journey takes him to the bustling Provencal port of Marseille - he begins the day there in the old port, where the fishermen are selling fresh seafood from the back of their boats. James buys some sea bass for an outdoor cook on the quayside - venturing into town, he then visits Marseille's oldest bakery and learns the history and importance of the famous navette biscuit. James then goes in search of the best example of Marseille's most famous dish - bouillabaisse - and takes his beloved 2CV to the world-famous Circuit Paul Ricard, where he prepares his take on piperade. In keeping with the fish and seafood theme, James also cooks scallops St Jacques and wreckfish with buckwheat.

Back home, Roger schemes to get revenge on Steve for eating one of his cookies by convincing him that he is adopted.

programme.title: American Dad!
programme.desc: Animated series about family man Stan Smith, who works for the CIA. When Stan forgets his wedding anniversary, he arranges to have 20 hours of Francine's memory erased, but the CIA temp on duty accidentally erases 20 years. Francine, having reverted to her wild child days, moves into her old apartment with Hayley as a roommate and ends up going to a festival with Hayley's boyfriend. Steve asks a good-looking girl out, but needs his wingman Roger to help him out and date her ugly cousin.

programme.title: G'wed
programme.desc: Comedy series providing an honest, uplifting and heart-warming portrayal of the lives of working-class teenagers from Liverpool while tackling issues with a refreshing humour. Ted is the envy of the school as he starts dating popular sixth-former Thomas - Ted finds Thomas's talk of their spiritual connection beguiling, and their electrifying romance is cemented when Thomas takes Ted to see the Gormley statues on Crosby Beach for the very first time. This is a side of Liverpool that Ted never knew existed and a way of looking at the world that captures his heart and imagination, but for all Thomas's talk of them being soulmates, Ted is left with a decision to make when it is revealed that his older lover is exploring ethical non-monogamy. Meanwhile, Mia-Louise is worried that Ziad might be gay as he doesn't want to have sex with her, Mo is still acting like a devout Muslim in the hope of getting closer with The Brimble, and Christopher and Aimee bond over their Romeo and Juliet scenes.

programme.title: Plebs
programme.desc: Sitcom set in ancient Rome. When the boys attend a free trial session at a swanky new bathhouse and attempt to outstay their welcome, Marcus courts a potential business contact he meets in the changing room while Jason starts dating a yoga instructor.

programme.title: Count Abdulla
programme.desc: Comedy series about twenty-something British-Pakistani Muslim doctor Abdulla Khan. Abdulla is desperate for some answers and unfaltering in his desire to find a cure to his vampirism when he agrees to go on a date with Kathy at her favourite haunt - once there, however, the out-of-place young Muslim can't shake the feeling that he is being watched by the coven and by Shafi, who turns up with his beautiful fiancee Nahima to intervene as Muslims don't do boyfriend-girlfriend dates! Elsewhere, Bushra and Shafi arrange for a marriage counsellor to see Abdulla to set him straight, but the man that turns up is not who they expect him to be... When the 'Halal double date' turns sour, Abdulla is forced to take protective action which sees the hitherto receptive Kathy return to her terrifying former self - now on the run, Abdulla drops down at Amrita's door but finds that her relationship status might be a little different to what he expected.

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: James's journey takes him to the bustling Provencal port of Marseille - he begins the day there in the old port, where the fishermen are selling fresh seafood from the back of their boats. James buys some sea bass for an outdoor cook on the quayside - venturing into town, he then visits Marseille's oldest bakery and learns the history and importance of the famous navette biscuit. James then goes in search of the best example of Marseille's most famous dish - bouillabaisse - and takes his beloved 2CV to the world-famous Circuit Paul Ricard, where he prepares his take on piperade. In keeping with the fish and seafood theme, James also cooks scallops St Jacques and wreckfish with buckwheat.

programme.title: Believe Me
programme.desc: In 2008, it becomes clear that a cab-driving serial rapist is operating in London. A new team led by Tim Grattan-Kane launches a desperate manhunt. An appeal leads a nurse who treated Laila to contact the police, which results in Worboys' arrest. Sarah and Laila, whose lives have been deeply affected by their traumatic experiences, learn of this via the media, which causes them distress. Dozens of other potential victims come forward, including Carrie, who realises that he must have drugged her too. The strong evidence leads to Worboys' conviction and he is sentenced to a minimum of eight years. Carrie agrees to waive her anonymity and do interviews to encourage other victims to step forward. Outraged by their treatment, Sarah and Laila approach renowned solicitor Harriet Wistrich and decide to take the unprecedented step of suing the Metropolitan Police. They are concerned about Worboys' minimum term of only eight years, but police reassure them that he is unlikely to receive parole.

programme.title: The Family Next Door
programme.desc: The first episode of an Australian mystery drama. An enigmatic woman, Isabelle, abruptly leaves a wake and drives interstate all the way to Osprey Point, a small coastal town in Victoria - she arrives at her rental in a quiet suburban cul-de-sac called Pleasant Court and is met by neighbour and nosy estate agent Ange. Ange gently pushes Isabelle for information and senses that Isabelle is not who she says she is - her interest is piqued and she is determined to find out more. Ange's intrigue of Isabelle infiltrates the Court - Fran, Essie, Lulu and Holly - and it isn't long before their regular 'wine o'clock' turns to gossip about this mysterious new neighbour.

programme.title: The Family Next Door
programme.desc: Australian mystery drama. Essie feels a disconnection with motherhood both physically and emotionally - living with her mother isn't helping, and she feels judged and guilt-ridden that her experience of motherhood is not joyful. After a frightening incident at the playground involving her baby, Essie gets to know her enigmatic new neighbour a little better - Isabelle seems to represent everything Essie once had with her freedom, adventure, sense of self and anonymity... and it's alluring. After the park, home life becomes even more claustrophobic with Barb and Ben aware of Essie's dishonesty - buoyed by her time with Isabelle, she gets honest with Ben about her feelings around motherhood. Elsewhere, Ange seeks some legal advice from Fran while remaining anxious about Isabelle and her interest with Lucas - especially after seeing them together at the Nippers BBQ - and Isabelle makes a shocking discovery after surprising Lucas at his studio with payment for his photography work.

programme.title: Believe Me
programme.desc: In 2008, it becomes clear that a cab-driving serial rapist is operating in London. A new team led by Tim Grattan-Kane launches a desperate manhunt. An appeal leads a nurse who treated Laila to contact the police, which results in Worboys' arrest. Sarah and Laila, whose lives have been deeply affected by their traumatic experiences, learn of this via the media, which causes them distress. Dozens of other potential victims come forward, including Carrie, who realises that he must have drugged her too. The strong evidence leads to Worboys' conviction and he is sentenced to a minimum of eight years. Carrie agrees to waive her anonymity and do interviews to encourage other victims to step forward. Outraged by their treatment, Sarah and Laila approach renowned solicitor Harriet Wistrich and decide to take the unprecedented step of suing the Metropolitan Police. They are concerned about Worboys' minimum term of only eight years, but police reassure them that he is unlikely to receive parole.

programme.title: The Family Next Door
programme.desc: The first episode of an Australian mystery drama. An enigmatic woman, Isabelle, abruptly leaves a wake and drives interstate all the way to Osprey Point, a small coastal town in Victoria - she arrives at her rental in a quiet suburban cul-de-sac called Pleasant Court and is met by neighbour and nosy estate agent Ange. Ange gently pushes Isabelle for information and senses that Isabelle is not who she says she is - her interest is piqued and she is determined to find out more. Ange's intrigue of Isabelle infiltrates the Court - Fran, Essie, Lulu and Holly - and it isn't long before their regular 'wine o'clock' turns to gossip about this mysterious new neighbour.

programme.title: The Family Next Door
programme.desc: Australian mystery drama. Essie feels a disconnection with motherhood both physically and emotionally - living with her mother isn't helping, and she feels judged and guilt-ridden that her experience of motherhood is not joyful. After a frightening incident at the playground involving her baby, Essie gets to know her enigmatic new neighbour a little better - Isabelle seems to represent everything Essie once had with her freedom, adventure, sense of self and anonymity... and it's alluring. After the park, home life becomes even more claustrophobic with Barb and Ben aware of Essie's dishonesty - buoyed by her time with Isabelle, she gets honest with Ben about her feelings around motherhood. Elsewhere, Ange seeks some legal advice from Fran while remaining anxious about Isabelle and her interest with Lucas - especially after seeing them together at the Nippers BBQ - and Isabelle makes a shocking discovery after surprising Lucas at his studio with payment for his photography work.

programme.title: The Tower
programme.desc: Crime thriller. Armed with an ID for Spencer's killer, Lizzie persuades Kieran to open up Operation Perseus to Sarah so she can make the arrest - however, it's clear that Sarah and Kieran loath one another even with Lizzie acting as a peacemaker. After testing Steve's cover at gunpoint, Shakiel invites him to become his number two - Kieran and Steve then realise that Shakiel is about to make a move that will give him control of south London, but they plan to be in the right place to stop him. Shakiel always has a card up his sleeve, though, and this time it's Ryan Kennedy.

James buys some sea bass for an outdoor cook on the quayside - venturing into town, he then visits Marseille's oldest bakery and learns the history and importance of the famous navette biscuit. James then goes in search of the best example of Marseille's most famous dish - bouillabaisse - and takes his beloved 2CV to the world-famous Circuit Paul Ricard, where he prepares his take on piperade.
